question: Thyroid gland, EXCEPT
question_ar: كل ما يتعلق بالغدة الدرقية صحيح باستثناء؟

options.text: It's composed of two lobes, weighs 25 grams in adult, each lobe 5 cm long, 3 cm wide, 2 cm thick
Superior thyroid vein drain to the internal jugular vein
It extends from the third tracheal ring up to sixth tracheal ring
